pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **The Backpass Assassin fumbles, while Bubba G knows how to win like champions.** France is coming off a dominant group stage and looks every bit the contender you'd expect from a world-class squad, and yet here we have Gayden, The Backpass Assassin, who drafted England— a team famous for underachieving when it matters most. It's like drafting a Ferrari that consistently loses to Hyundai. This is a joke. England's recent loss to Argentina proves my point; their fragile psyche will crumble against France's flair and tenacity. On the other hand, Gunner, or "Bubba G," clearly understood the assignment by picking France in Tier 1, a team built for glory. Unlike Gayden, whose knowledge seems to evaporate under pressure, Bubba G executed a draft strategy that reflects a mind steeped in actual football understanding. England stands no chance here, folks. Expect Bubba G's France to thump the English and further cement Gayden's role as the comic relief of this fantasy pool.
